1. (Currently amended) A packaging substrate comprising: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having a plurality of conductive paths formed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the conductive paths configured to provide electrical connection between an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, wherein the opening __exposes a solder mask layer and extends through the solder mask layer to expose an underlying core layer__; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, __wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface and is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface or a sidewall of the opening__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein __the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a sidewall of the opening__.

5. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein __the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer to expose a portion of an underlying core layer__.

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising: an integrated circuit chip mounted on the chip mounting surface, __wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface__.

8. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 7, wherein the stiffening microstructure __includes a lid that is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface or a sidewall of the opening__.

9. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 8 further comprising: a heat transfer medium providing a thermally conductive pathway between the lid and the integrated circuit chip, __wherein the heat transfer medium is disposed between the lid and the integrated circuit chip in a manner that improves thermal conductivity and package coplanarity__.

10. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is a ring __that extends above the chip mounting surface and is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface or a sidewall of the opening__.

11. (Cancelled)

12. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a dielectric bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

13. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a conductive bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

14. (Currently amended) A computing device, comprising: a memory; and a packaged semiconductor device communicatively coupled to the memory, wherein the packaged semiconductor device comprises: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, __wherein the opening exposes a solder mask layer and extends through the solder mask layer to expose an underlying core layer__; an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and communicatively coupled to the memory through the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, __wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface and is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface or a sidewall of the opening__.

15. (Cancelled)

16. (Cancelled)

17. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer __to expose a portion of an underlying core layer__.

18. (Cancelled)

19. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure __includes one of a ring or a lid, and extends above the chip mounting surface__.

20. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is in contact with ground reference plane layer.
